question: Why would a dull-witted person neglect service at the goddess's feet?
premises: Service at the feet is the proper devotion
Some people are bewildered about this service
A dull intellect fails to serve properly
inference: The verse questions why a dull-witted person serves the bewildered instead of serving at the goddess's feet
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of vimuhān is somewhat compressed
plain_english: Why indeed does one of dull intellect serve those bewildered, instead of serving at her feet?
